        "path": "solution.py",
        "old_text": "def atomic_write_text(path, text):
    temporary = path.with_suffix('.tmp')

        "new_text": "def atomic_write_text(path, text):
    temporary = path.with_suffix('.tmp')
    try:
        temporary.write_text(text)
        path.write_text(text)
    finally:
        if temporary.exists():
            temporary.unlink()"
    }
}
